title: An eventual exact full-B2 lower bound with coefficient 628119274124457367309274931/123070533181185612740000000

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. experiments.purpose: Both runs establish the joint theorem. The initial {"phase":"energy"} regenerates all 123635 pairs at sweep 24, verifies energy and initial majority, and checks 51660 entropy cells in partition 0. Request {"phase":"terminal"} to continue the same prefix by 28 sweeps, bound terminal majority, and check 62521 entropy cells in partition 1. Verify both phases and their matching prefix digests.
